links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRES, GFI) of LLM patient education text versus general public health literacy level
links.effect: DeepSeek FKGL 10.28 vs ChatGPT 8.84 (p<0.001); FRES and GFI similar between groups; readability of both models exceeds general public's health literacy level.
links.quote: However, the text readability of both models exceeds the general public's health literacy level.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education materials
links.effect: DeepSeek FKGL 10.28 vs ChatGPT 8.84 (p<0.001); both models' readability exceeds general public health literacy level.
links.quote: However, the text readability of both models exceeds the general public's health literacy level.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the quality, reliability, and readability of responses generated by two LLMs (ChatGPT and DeepSeek) to patient education questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
